title: Compress PDF to 100KB
description: Shrink your large PDF documents under 100KB for government portals, job applications, or visa forms completely in your browser.

sections.title: Shrink PDF to 100KB Instantly & Securely
sections.content: Struggling with strict 100KB upload limits on government portals, job sites, or visa applications? Our local compressor optimizes your PDF file under 100KB in seconds.

steps.title: Add PDF Document
steps.description: Drop your PDF file into the client-side compressor.

steps.title: Select 100KB Target
steps.description: Choose strong compression to automatically target size under 100KB.

steps.title: Save Optimized PDF
steps.description: Download your compressed PDF instantly, ready to upload.

sections.title: Perfect for CPNS, Visa, and Scholarship Portals
sections.content: No need to worry about server-side limits. All compression takes place in your local browser sandbox, ensuring absolute compliance with security rules.
sections.subTitle: Upload with Peace of Mind
sections.subContent: We process your sensitive documents (ID card scan, passport, CV) 100% locally. Zero risk of data leak.

sections.title: Lossless Density Management
sections.content: Optimizes image resolution and DPI scales to hit the 100KB threshold without turning texts into illegible blur.

faqs.q: How do I ensure the file is under 100KB?
faqs.a: Select the 'Strong' compression preset. Our tool optimizes vectors and rasterizes complex gradients to fit your file under 100KB.

faqs.q: Is there a limit on how many files I can compress?
faqs.a: No. Since processing runs locally in your browser memory, you can compress as many files as you want.
Yes. They are processed entirely offline via WebAssembly. 0 bytes are uploaded.
